name: Brooks B17 Carved saddle
description:
For riders in search of pressure relief, the B17 Carved features a "registered cutting" which first appeared with Brooks saddles in the 1890s.
Still providing relief today, the B17 Carved is made from vegetable tanned leather that will age beautifully over time. Additionally, laced saddle flaps allow for increased tension and preserve the saddle’s shape.
A more flexible saddle than the standard B17, this comfortable saddle is finished with steel rivets and a steel undercarriage.
Includes black, red, white and blue laces so you can add your personal flair.

description:

name: Ritchey WCS Streem saddle - titanium rail
description:

name: Ritchey Comp Skyline saddle
description:
The Ritchey Comp Skyline saddle keeps the ergonomic curve that supports sit bones and the generous cut-out to relieve perineal pressure.
Built with a unique manufacturing technology that adheres the synthetic saddle cover to the nylon & carbon fiber base without any visible seams, glue, stitching or staples, the Skyline is waterproof, will last longer and keeps the weight to a minimum.
The saddle padding is made from a new lightweight polyurethane material that is 30% more shock absorbent than traditional foam, which reduces rider fatigue.
The Comp Skyline also features a curved, two-axis shape that bring a rise toward the rear of the saddle and a bit of lift to the nose. This shape is ideal for riders who lack flexibility and want more support, yet still offers a good position for riders who demand a healthy dose of performance with their comfort.
Another highlight of the Comp Skyline is Ritchey's revolutionary patented Vector Wing technology, which helps eliminate hots spots by dissipating pressure more evenly for all-day comfort for wherever your pedal strokes take you: road, gravel, trails and beyond.

name: Fizik Vento Antares R5 saddle - 140mm
description:
Making race-ready performance more accessible, the Fizik Antares R5 i s a low profile saddle with a transition from nose to wing that helps deliver efficient pedaling in every riding positions, and maintains many iconic design features made popular amongst leading athletes spanning two decades.
No matter if you're attacking a climb or holding the tempo on flat terrain, this saddle is designed to support you. Moving fore and aft has been made easier by a flatter, slightly wider nose that acts as an optimal base from which to produce power.
The Anteres R5 utilizes S-Alloy hollow rails, dual, density foam padding, a carbon reinforced nylon shell and Wing Flex technology, which allows the shell's side edges flex and adapt to the rider's inner leg movement for more efficient pedaling and full-range of motion regardless of the rider's position along the saddle, and also features  an ergonomic cutout to helps to relieve pressure and facilitate blood flow.

Available in 140mm and 150mm widths.
